prompt: A bicycle wheel has radius $12$ inches. If it turns through $30^\circ$, how far along the rim does a spot of gum travel? Give your answer in inches in terms of $\pi$ — for example, type "3pi" for $3\pi$.
hint: The formula $s = r\theta$ only works when $\theta$ is in radians, so convert first.

hints.text: The formula $s = r\theta$ only works when $\theta$ is in radians, so convert first.

explanation: The 12 and the 6 reduce, leaving $s = 2\pi$ inches (about 6.28 inches).

alternativeExplanations.title: Slice of the whole rim
steps: The full rim is a circumference of $2\pi r = 24\pi$ inches.
